title: Transfer Center: ICU Patient Evacuation Request

transcript.speaker: Transfer Center
transcript.text: The Transfer Center at a neighboring hospital to Ottawa River. We have six ICU patients on your list and capacity in our MICU. We need a summary for each: diagnosis, medications, allergies, and last labs. We cannot access your EHR. How will you send it, and who will give the physician-to-physician report?

transcript.speaker: EDMD
transcript.text: Understood. We’ll provide a printed summary from the BCA-VIEW01 viewer and the paper record. I’ll give the report to your physician directly.

transcript.speaker: Transfer Center
transcript.text: Good. Send the list to our transfer coordinator, Dr. Elaine Whitfield, via secure fax at 555-0151. We’ll confirm receipt.

instructorNote: This inject tests patient transfer coordination under downtime. Watch for the CNO and EDMD to use the BCA-VIEW01 viewer and paper record, and for them to initiate the transfer via the correct contact and method.
